Description: This command is used to retrieve the list of forms available on the device.

OutputParam.Value: LPSTR lpszFormList; lpszFormList Pointer to a list of null-terminated form names, with the final name terminating with two null characters. Error Codes Only the generic error codes defined in [Ref. 1] can be generated by this command. Comments None. 24 CWA 16926-4:2020 (E)
